verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation acceptance condition that the opening proposal letter fit on one page.

value_updates.signature_insertion_in_canva: The client must be able to insert her signature easily in Canva.
value_updates.displaced_photo_handling: If the two photographs do not fit in the one-page letter, relocate them to another proposal section.

verdicts.decision_note: The client adds concrete layout behavior for Canva signature insertion and relocation of the two displaced photographs while retaining the one-page letter constraint.
